question: What offerings should the year-long officiant give to the deceased?
premises: An officiant serves for the year.
Offerings are to be made to the deceased.
Food and a pot of water are specified.
inference: The year-long officiant should give food together with a pot of water to the deceased.
uncertainties: The exact role denoted by saṃvatsadguruḥ is context-dependent.
plain_english: The year-long officiant should also give him food together with a pot of water.
